headline: Ends a national emergency the US had declared over nuclear bomb-grade material stockpiled in Russia.
what_it_does: This order ends an earlier national emergency about the risk that weapons-usable nuclear material in Russia could spread to others. Ending the emergency also ends the special presidential powers that came with it. The title does not explain the reasons or any related changes, so the details are limited.

who_it_affects.group: The Russian government and companies dealing with US nuclear material programs
who_it_affects.how: Any special emergency rules tied to this declaration no longer apply to them.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that enforced the emergency rules
who_it_affects.how: They no longer carry out actions under this emergency.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, May 26, 2015; the title does not confirm the exact date.
